Iran sets 7 conditions for talks with US, warns of war

Iran has communicated seven conditions for potential talks with the United States, and is awaiting a response from President Trump. The country has stated it is prepared for a "decisive war" if these conditions are not met. Iran has reiterated these conditions for ending the conflict with the US.
